review_notes: I read the whole file. It declares no @[simp] lemmas or simp sets. It only removes simp attributes from upstream lemmas, and that removal looks deliberate. All its lemmas are private, and each is applied through explicit `rw`, `exact`, `simp only [...]` or `simpa`. I found no cycles, competing rules or unwanted expansion. Candidate lemmas such as `coe_algebraMap'`, `mem_nonunits_iff_ord_pos` and the `HasValue.sub/neg/add` lemmas are not clearly worth a simp attribute. They are private, are used at specific call sites, and some of them need side conditions like `hf : f ≠ 0`. I did not trace every upstream simp lemma, so I may have missed a clash with an upstream simp set.
